searchText: Not entirely sure which channel would be most appropriate for this, but the Go Ethereum discord is a complete ghost town.. I was hoping to find out if there was a way to set the eth.gasPrice on the node level for geth, rather than take it from the chain? I know there's GasPrice and PriceLimit, but these simply seem to apply to minimum acceptance. Is there a way to ensure that all estimates passed to clients (e.g. Metamask) use a configured gas rate? That would be a per-client question, so the client discord/Element server(s) would be the right place to ask. Yeah, sadly the Go Ethereum Discord hasn’t had anyone with knowledge post there in several days.
